name: v26.0.2
body:
This is the final release of AdvantageScope for 2026 and includes several minor bug fixes. Documentation is available [online](https://github.com/Mechanical-Advantage/AdvantageScope/blob/main/docs/INDEX.md) or by clicking the 📖 icon in the app. Feedback, feature requests, and bug reports are welcome on the [issues page](https://github.com/Mechanical-Advantage/AdvantageScope/issues). * Fixed automatic video synchronization for 2026 matches (#489, @blaze-developer) * Fixed crashing when opening large REVLOG files (#512, @rylanmoseley) * Fixed calculation of integrated values on stepped line graphs with AdvantageKit logs (#504, @blaze-developer) * Added support for Kelvin units to fix parsing of temperature values in WPILib base units (#484, @blaze-developer)
